events.title: New DriftBorne Trailer and Release Date
events.summary: New DriftBorne TrailerA brand-new trailer for DriftBorne is now live.It gives a much better look at the game’s tone, story, characters, and overall atmosphere than the previous teaser.DriftBorne releases on November 18, 2026.If you haven’t already, you can wishlist the game here:Thanks a lot, guys. I’m working hard on the game and really appreciate all the support so far. Kind regards, Jamleng.

events.title: Finally! We're Live!
events.summary: After a long time in development, I’m really happy to finally share the Steam page for the new project, DriftBorne! This one has been in the works for quite a while and is something completely different from what I’ve done before. More grounded, more personal, and hopefully a lot more immersive.Some of you might remember the previous game, which was completed after four years of hard work and became one of the largest AVNs out there.
